sentence_text: Our Services and How We Use Personal Information
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: We use and make available PI for various purposes in connection with the products and services we offer.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: For instance:
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: a. We help marketers to deliver, target and optimize direct mail and email campaigns, display, mobile and social media marketing;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: b. We help marketers to measure the effectiveness of ad campaigns (online and offline), such as by determining which messages are most likely to be seen or opened by which types of consumers, or which types of ads are most likely to lead to purchases;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: c. We create sets of consumer attributes – categories of personal interests that are grouped together based on common interests or preferences (“Data Segments”).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: These Data Segments may be associated with a person, household, or when used online, a unique online identifier, such as enjoying sports, travel, living in a middle-class neighborhood, or being a member of a certain profession.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Marketers may use these Data Segments to tailor more relevant ads and offers to groups of users, or to learn more about their own customers and improve their own databases.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: d. We provide other data services, such as (but not limited to) verification, record look-ups, anti-fraud services, B2B records and services, and other analytics and database tools.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: We may use PI and Data Segments to help marketers and other data platforms perform “cross-channel” marketing – analyzing, locating and creating potential marketing “audiences” through multiple channels, e.g., web and mobile, or TV/radio.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: In addition, when we work with online marketing applications such as through web-based, mobile, or cable TV technologies, these marketing applications may de-identify PI (such as by creating a “hashed” version of an email address, or another associated identifier) in order to reach consumers through online display media.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: These marketing applications use cookies and similar technologies, often associated with unique online identifiers.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: We try to help our clients tailor their advertising to the consumers most likely interested in their product, service or cause and to help our clients analyze and improve their marketing.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Others

sentence_text: To do this, we match our clients’ customer information to a specific consumer by comparing name and postal address or other offline identifiers or email address or other online identifiers.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Others

sentence_text: We are then able to associate a consumer or a de-identified consumer profile with other data, including demographic data, social media informed data, geographic data, transaction data and transaction-based insights, and other interest-based data.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Others

sentence_text: We analyze the data we have about consumers, such as purchase, subscription or donation information, demographic information, social media interests and other consumer information, using statistical models designed to predict consumer interest in specific offers from particular businesses and non-profit causes or in categories of product, service or cause.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Others

sentence_text: Our models predict not only who might be interested in our clients’ offers but which consumers are likely to have little or no interest in them.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Others

sentence_text: This can help improve our clients’ marketing decisions, which helps reduce the amount of irrelevant advertising consumers see and saves our clients money.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Others

sentence_text: Once we complete our analysis, we provide our clients with the results in a format designed for the way they intend to use it.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: For example, when clients use our products to send direct mail or to better understand likely interests of their existing customers or donors, we typically provide our clients information associated with names and postal addresses or other individually identifying information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: When our clients ask for help to connect with potentially interested consumers through digital channels, such as online or mobile advertising, we would typically provide our products in de-identified form using industry standard privacy practices.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: In these cases, we, or our client, or partner will combine the results of our analyses with digital identifiers in the applicable digital channel (such as with cookie IDs or other identifiers for web advertising, device IDs for mobile advertising or email addresses for email advertising).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: When our clients want information or recommendations about how to improve the effectiveness of their marketing, we may use our analysis to create aggregated reports about their customers or donors or about groups of consumers and their interests relative to the client’s product, service or cause.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: Marketers routinely use basic demographic information to ensure that consumers are aware of opportunities, causes, and products very likely to be important to them because of the groups to which they belong or with which they affiliate.

sentence_text: For example, religious organizations often seek donations from those who express interest in causes related to a particular religious affiliation.

sentence_text: Here the intent is clear: to find people belonging to or sympathetic to a particular religious belief or denomination in order to effectively communicate with them for the betterment of the group.

sentence_text: Similarly, commercial organizations frequently seek to study the make-up of their customer base and to develop products and marketing offers that will appeal to racial or ethnic groups that are under-represented in their customer base.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: The intent is not to discriminate, but rather to be more inclusive.

sentence_text: We seek to support our clients’ efforts to pursue affirmative, tailored advertising like the examples just mentioned, and where permitted by law, we may process this type of basic demographic information as part of doing so.

sentence_text: We do not accept or generate information specifying individuals’ health conditions (such as protected health information, aka “HIPAA data”) and do not seek to predict that any person has a particular health condition.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: We do serve clients that sell health-related products, which can range from non-prescription items such as maternity apparel and vitamins and supplements to prescription drugs.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: In all cases, our predictions are designed to identify those with likely interest in a product or service, and not a specific medical condition.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: In other words, we predict whether a person may be interested in buying these types of products (for themselves or others), but we do it without individual health information and do not predict that a person has a particular health condition on behalf of our clients or partners.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: In these cases, our predictive technology would seek to identify interest in the product, which might include consumers with a particular health condition and also consumers without the health condition.

sentence_text: For example, for retailers selling maternity apparel, our predictive models seek to predict interest in that type of apparel, which will likely include those who are expectant parents (which we would not know), but also those who are not expectant parents (which we also would not know) but are likely to buy for other reasons, for example as a gift for others.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: In every case we strive to identify and follow industry best practices around consumer privacy and ethical use of data when making these predictions.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: We don’t work with our clients on offers relative to marketing for products or services that are meant for those with health conditions we consider to be highly sensitive, such as sexually transmitted diseases or cancer.

sentence_text: Geo-fencing
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: We or our service providers may deliver ads to your mobile device when you are in certain geographic locations.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: This type of targeted advertising is referred to as “geo-fencing” or “geo-targeting.”
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: Geo-fencing works by placing a “fence” around a certain geographic (“geo”) location.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: For example, we or one of our service providers could create a 2 square mile “fence” around a grocery store.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: When you go inside that fence or target area, we or our service providers may serve you specific ads based on your being in that target area.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: In such instance, you may, for example, be served ads about the grocery store or a product sold in that grocery store.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: With geo-fencing we do not continuously, periodically, or intermittently track your precise location.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Others

sentence_text: The geo location of your device will, however, be provided to us or one of our service partners when you enter the target area, and we may also be provided other Non-PII.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Others

sentence_text: Geo-fencing monitors an area and sends notifications either to an app you have on your mobile device or directly to us or our service providers when the boundary is crossed, either in or out.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Others

sentence_text: Those apps use this location information to process status updates only if you have geo-location enabled on your mobile device.

sentence_text: We will not target you with ads based on your geo-location unless we believe you have provided consent to do so.

sentence_text: For example, if an advertiser wants us to display ads to individuals who have expressed interest in acne, sun-care products, or advances in treating certain medical conditions, we may serve ads for those products or services to those individuals based on segment data and Internet browsing habits.

sentence_text: This type of targeted advertising is referred to as “geo-fencing” or “geo-targeting.”
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: Geo-fencing works by placing a “fence” around a certain geographic (“geo”) location.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: For example, we or one of our service providers could create a 2 square mile “fence” around a grocery store.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Others

sentence_text: With geo-fencing we do not continuously, periodically, or intermittently track your precise location.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Others

sentence_text: The geo location of your device will, however, be provided to us or one of our service partners when you enter the target area, and we may also be provided other Non-PII.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Others

sentence_text: Geo-fencing monitors an area and sends notifications either to an app you have on your mobile device or directly to us or our service providers when the boundary is crossed, either in or out.

sentence_text: Information You Provide
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: We collect information that you voluntarily provide to us while using the Services, such as when you register an account, make a purchase of one of our products or services, respond to our customer surveys, submit a data correction request, communicate with our customer service team, or apply for a job.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: The information we collect includes information relating to identified or identifiable natural persons.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: The categories of information we collect include the following: contact data, including your first and last name, telephone number, email address, and postal address; billing information; credentials, including your passwords; content data, including the content of the messages you send to us; IP addresses or IP ranges you submit; and resume data, including data necessary to consider you for a job opening (such as your employment history, writing samples, and references).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: We also use payment processes to collect and process payment data, including your payment instrument and security code associated with your payment instrument, on our behalf.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Information Collected Automatically
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: We automatically collect information about your device and how your device interacts with our Services.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: The categories of information we automatically collect, and the methods by which we may collect such information include the following:
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Cookies, Web Beacons, and Embedded Scripts
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: The Services use "cookies" and similar technologies, including HTML5 local storage.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: MaxMind uses cookies and other technologies to identify your device, identify authorized users of the MaxMind Account Portal, track affiliate referrals, complete online purchases through MaxMind's shopping carts, and similar Services monitoring activities.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: MaxMind may also use web beacons, small graphic images or other web programming code (also known as "1x1 GIFs" or "clear GIFs"), which may be included in our web pages and e-mail messages.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Web beacons or similar technologies may be used for a number of purposes, including, without limitation, to count visitors to the Services, to monitor how users navigate the Services, to count how many e-mails that were sent were actually opened or to count how many particular articles or links were actually viewed.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: MaxMind may also use embedded scripts in connection with the provision of its Services. "
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Embedded scripts" are programming code designed to collect information about your interactions with a website, such as the links you click on, and may assist our customers in providing us with information used to provide the Services.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: The code is temporarily downloaded onto your device from our web server, our customer's web server, or a service provider or other party, is active only while you are connected to the website containing the embedded script, and is deactivated or deleted thereafter.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Log File Information
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Your web browser automatically sends information to every website you visit, including ours.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: For example, our server logs may receive and record information such as the pages you access on the Services, referring URLs, your browser type, your operating system, the date and time of your visit, and the duration of your visit to each page.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: User Agent Strings
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Log file information may also include a user agent string, a series of characters automatically sent with your Internet requests that provide information necessary for smooth Internet communications, such as the operating system and browser you used.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: A user agent string might be used to identify the device originating a message.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Non-Precise Location Data
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: MaxMind may also request access to or otherwise receive information about your device location when you access the Services.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Your location data may be based on your IP address, which is non-precise.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: For clarity, MaxMind does not request access to or otherwise receive GPS signals from any devices when you access the Services.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: We use location data in connection with providing the Services and to help improve the Services.

sentence_text: Unique Identification Number
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: MaxMind may assign your computer or mobile device a unique identification number ("Unique ID") based on log file information when you access the Services.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: MaxMind may set a cookie on your device containing, amongst other things, the device's Unique ID.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: MaxMind uses information generated from the Unique ID for purposes of improving our Services, primarily our ability to detect fraud.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: MaxMind does not share the Unique ID or any associated data with unaffiliated parties in the traditional sense of sharing.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: However, some of the services offered by MaxMind, including some that are available through the Services, may require the placement of a snippet of JavaScript on the customer's own website (either by the customer itself or by MaxMind), and that JavaScript collects the information used by MaxMind to create the Unique ID.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: If the customer uses the MaxMind minFraud service, it may receive back the Unique ID MaxMind associated with the IP address being used in the request made to the minFraud service.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Information Collected through the GeoIP2 JavaScript Client API
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: MaxMind offers a GeoIP2 JavaScript Client API available to its customers via geoip-js.com and js.maxmind.com.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Where a MaxMind customer uses the GeoIP2 JavaScript Client API, MaxMind collects IP addresses and other information (e.g., HTTP headers) provided via geoip-js.com or js.maxmind.com on behalf of the customer, and logs such information only for the purposes of monitoring, alerting, and internal reporting for the specific customer for up to 30 days.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: NextRoll’s Technology helps our D2C and B2B Customers provide ads and send emails to people that are most likely to find them interesting by showing them ads that are relevant to their specific interests.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: This is called “interest-based advertising”.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: We show many of these interest-based ads on websites and mobile apps which rely on advertising revenue to support the content they provide - and what we all consume - for free each day.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: When you visit a website or a mobile application (each a “Digital Property”) operated by one of our Customers, open an email from a Customer, or get served an ad by us on behalf of our Customer on a third party site, we may collect certain data from your device as described in this Service Privacy Notice.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Our platform then uses that data, as well as other data described in What Data We Collect, to help our Customers provide ads and send emails to you that aim to be more relevant to you.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: To see an example of how this works in practice, see Example of Interest-Based Advertising.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Interest-based advertising enables publishers of Digital Properties to more accurately determine which ads to serve to specific users based on near real-time data.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: In turn, this allows our Customers to provide more effective advertising that reaches a more precise pool of prospective buyers.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: All in all, interest-based advertising promotes better competition in the marketplace (for example, small and medium sized companies have a better opportunity to reach as many prospective buyers as large, well-funded, competitors), and allows our Customers to provide free or low-cost content to their customers due to the resources generated by effective advertising.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Example of Interest-Based Advertising
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: You’re working from home for the foreseeable future and want to invest in more comfortable work-from-home clothing.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: You can’t go to the store right now so you decide to peruse some e-commerce sites instead.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: You go to Google and type in “loungewear” and a list of websites pop up, including one for ABC Sweatshirts.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: You’re still in the research phase so you browse their site but don’t purchase.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Luckily, ABC Sweatshirts is a customer of NextRoll and uses the AdRoll technology for its e-commerce platform.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Our technology notes that your device visited ABC Loungwear’s website and was looking at sweatshirts.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Later, as you browse the Internet, we show you ads online from ABC Sweatshirts to encourage you to come back and purchase the sweatshirt, perhaps even with a discount offer or notice of an upcoming sale.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: We may also show you ads from other companies that sell similar products or services you may be interested in to complete your loungewear outfit, such as sweatpants or home slippers.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: In addition, if you gave ABC Sweatshirts your email address for marketing purposes, we may also send you emails on behalf of the brand that tell you about its new exclusive line of sweatshirts, special promotions, and more.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Alternatively, we may use your email to serve you interest-based ads on social media (for example, your social media provider may match a pseudonymized form of your email address that we provide them with the email address details you have registered with your social media account, enabling us to show you interest-based ads in your social media newsfeed).
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Measurement and Attribution
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared;Others

sentence_text: In addition to interest-based advertising, we also provide various analytics to help our Customers measure the success of their advertising campaigns and identify prospective buyers who may be the most interested in their products or services.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: For instance, by collecting a unique identifier (such as a cookie ID) from the devices of users who see our Customers’ ads or visit their Digital Properties, we can measure whether those unique identifiers subsequently took a particular action, such as buying a Customer’s product or visiting their Digital Property (sometimes called a “conversion”).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: In some cases, we may use our cross device data asset to match unique identifiers (which includes browsing activity) to email addresses.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Customers are only notified of a match if the email already exists in the Customer ‘s CRM records.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: AdRoll’s D2C Services can collect, measure and analyze different types of data in conjunction with these unique identifiers and provide useful information to our AdRoll Customers such as what IP address ranges visitors to their Digital Properties are from (indicating the geographic locations of a visitor, which may help indicate what locations to run a particular ad campaign), what products or services located on their Digital Property are attracting more attention (or less), and what ad campaigns ultimately led a cookie ID back to a Digital Property to view more products or make a purchase.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: RollWorks’ B2B Services provide similar types of analytics derived from the same sort of data as AdRoll’s D2C Services described above, but with a focus on firmographic information to provide insights on the type of B2B customers that appear to be interested in specific products or offerings on that Customer’s Digital Property.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: For example, determining which IP address ranges are associated with a unique identifier (such as a cookie ID) so we can identify companies who may be interested in our Customer’s product or service, or, if a unique identifier is linked to an email address that has already been provided to the B2B customer, RollWorks may alert the Customer of increased browsing activity that indicates interest from a particular known account.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Overall, we use the information learned from unique identifier behavior across the Internet to provide reporting to both our D2C and B2B Customers.
verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

verbatim_labels: Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: We use this data to better understand the Customers’ target audience and to better market the Customers’ products and services to you.

sentence_text: We may also work with our Customers and Audience Partners to synchronize their unique, pseudonymous identifiers to our own to enable us to more accurately recognize a particular unique browser or device and the advertising interests associated with it (commonly known as “ID or User Syncing”).

sentence_text: For example, we work with ad exchanges, publishers and supply side platforms (i.e. companies that sell advertising space on publishers’ websites) in order to serve our ads.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Others

sentence_text: Matching cookie identifiers helps us deliver ads to you and recognize you across browsers and devices and may include pseudonymous advertising identifiers (meaning identifiers that help identify your browser or device, but not you directly) which some Advertising Partners choose to share with us.

sentence_text: Our goal is to leverage this data to help Customers better identify and engage with you and, in turn, provide you with an ideal online experience whereby ad-sponsored content is available for free and the ads served to you are for products and services that aim to be relevant and interesting to you.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: The data we collect also helps Customers analyze traffic on their Digital Properties, measure the effectiveness of their ad campaigns and gauge the interest of prospective buyers.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Additionally, we use this data to operate, improve and enhance our Services.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Specifically, we use this data for the following purposes:
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Interest-Based Advertising:  To select ads that are more likely to be relevant to you based on data such as your browsing activity, the time of day and time spent visiting specific Digital Properties, and non-precise geographic data inferred about your device(s).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: For example, we may show you ads for your favorite shopping site (or similar sites we think you may like) for goods or services only available in your city, region or country during your lunch or commute hours.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Segmenting Audiences:  To segment you into groups (like bargain hunters, high intent visitors, low intent visitors) for certain purposes such as reporting and analytics as well as determining what ads and email content would best peak your interest.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: To do so, we use data from Customer Digital Properties you visit in addition to data provided by the Customer and Audience Partners (i.e. demographic and firmographic information about your unique identifier).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Ad Delivery:  We use data about your browser or other technical information about your device in order to technically deliver advertising and confirm successful delivery of the ad.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Frequency Capping:  We use data about the ads that have been served to you to make sure you will not see the same ad too many times.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: If we know you’ve already seen one of our Customer’s ads several times, we’ll try to show you a different ad next time.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Sequencing:  If you are being served a sequence of ads, to make sure we show you the right ad next in the sequence.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Mapping data to Our Cross-Device Asset: NextRoll’s cross-device asset is used to connect multiple devices to one person, household, and/or online identifiers such as an email address (hashed for security) that a Customer may have collected directly from its customers.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: The cross-device asset allows companies to better understand their known-customer activity, as well as improves the ability to target and measure ad campaigns (including limiting the number of times the same person or household sees an ad).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Cross-device matching: Identifying different devices and browsers that are likely to be associated with you so that ads can be targeted, capped and sequenced across those devices, and so that campaign effectiveness can be measured and analyzed.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Others

sentence_text: For example, cross-device matching helps us not show you ads for the shoes you were looking at on your phone but already purchased on your tablet.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Others

sentence_text: Instead we’ll try to show you ads for an upcoming triathlon where you can put those shoes to work.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Others

sentence_text: It also helps us match devices so we can honor your opt-out choices across all devices we know are connected to the opted-out cookie.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Others

sentence_text: You may opt-out of cross-device interest-based targeting by employing the respective opt-out techniques we describe in Your Choices and Opting-Out of Targeted Ads.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected;Others

sentence_text: To learn more about how we use cross-device matching, visit our blog.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Syncing Online Identifiers with Customer CRM Data: Customers may use NextRoll Services to match online browsing activity indicated by online identifiers with existing email addresses the Customer has already obtained ( i.e. Customer CRM Data).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Customers may also use this information to understand which consumers or business accounts are showing increased interest to better understand their website audience and respond with appropriate marketing activity.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Identifying Companies Associated with an IP Range for B2B marketing:  We match IP address ranges to companies who disclose their IP address ranges in order to provide aggregated reports to companies regarding their website traffic.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Reporting and Attribution:  By analyzing activity on our Customers’ Digital Properties, we provide our Customers insights into how their ad campaigns are performing and surface insights about their site visitors.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Reporting may include ad metrics, such as traffic on certain Digital Properties, measuring impact of campaigns, impressions (ads served), clicks (ads you clicked on) and conversions.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: What qualifies as a “conversion” is defined by the Customer—it might include, for example, a sale or a white paper download or a correlation to an actual or inferred sale, site visit or store visit.

sentence_text: We use UUIDs, IP Address and other Usage Information so that we can serve interesting recommendations.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: When you, as a User, first visit a Partner Site (e.g., CNN.com), Outbrain drops a cookie on your device in order to generate a UUID.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Alternatively, if you first interact with a Partner using that Partner’s application, Outbrain receives your advertiser ID which is assigned to you by your device.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: We catalogue and analyze the content you consume across Partner Sites.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Our recommendations are based on: (i) a UUIDs browsing history; (ii) similar browsing patterns of other Users; (iii) recommendations that are generally popular with Outbrain’s audience at this time; (iv) some randomness, and (v) targeting requirements that may be provided or requested by our Amplify clients.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: As an example, Outbrain may know that UUID 123 (which could be you on your iPhone X on The Guardian using Chrome as your browser) likes to read about far away holiday destinations and that people who like to read about far away holiday destinations also like to read about exotic food.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: When you interact with Outbrain we do not collect traditional personal data from you, like your email address or name, therefore we cannot associate your name with your UUID (for example, we do not know that John Smith, who is also UUID 123, likes to read about far away holiday destinations).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: For example, you will have one UUID when you visit a Partner Site from your mobile phone using the browser Safari, and a different UUID when you visit a Partner Site from your iPad using the browser Safari.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Outbrain will combine and consolidate a UUID from a mobile device (handheld or tablet) from a browser that then accesses an application (or vice versa) from that same device.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Outbrain does not conduct cross device tracking and therefore cannot link a user interacting with Outbrain on their phone as the same user who is interacting with Outbrain on their desktop.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: In addition to your UUID, we recognise your IP address, which we translate into geolocation and delete the last octet in order to mask the identifying information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: We then use this masked information, in conjunction with information we received from other trusted third party partners (such as MaxMind) to determine a broad understanding of where you are located (e.g., New York).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: Outbrain will still recognise your IP address even if you opt out of personalised tracking as this is necessary to continue serving you context-based recommendations however, in such instances your IP address is not associated with your UUID and would not form part of any user profile.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI Collected

sentence_text: In addition to Outbrain’s visible widget on Partner Sites, certain Outbrain advertisers may implement the Outbrain pixel on their websites.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: The Outbrain pixel determines whether the User reaching the page where the pixel is installed has an Outbrain UUID in order to provide reporting to advertisers in respect of their particular campaign.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: If there is a UUID associated with such end user, Outbrain allows advertisers to either retarget those UUIDs and/or provides advertisers with the total number of Users (on an aggregated and anonymised basis) that reached a particular page (for example, an advertiser does not know that UUID1234 converted but only that 1 conversion took place).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Outbrain does not pass its advertisers any personal data (including your UUID) or collect any further personal data via the pixel.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Outbrain does not combine information received from the Outbrain pixel information with a UUID’s profile (for example, Outbrain only tracks that 1 conversion has taken place and not the UUID123 has converted when it reaches the advertiser’s chosen page).
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: Outbrain may also allow certain trusted third party partners to collect data via cookies delivered through the Outbrain widget.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold;Description of Right to Know PI sold / shared

sentence_text: In such cases, Outbrain does not pass these third parties the data which Outbrain collects on its Users but allows such third parties to directly collect data (including personal data) via the widget for fraud and/or security purposes or in order to provide measurement information to advertisers (such as the number of conversions and/or impressions).

sentence_text: Ad Measurement Analysis: We use information we collect (such as location information and Advertising IDs) to assist advertisers with analyzing ad campaign performance – for example, by measuring how (or whether) Devices that were served with a particular ad engaged with the advertiser’s products or services.

sentence_text: This is sometimes called ad measurement or attribution analysis.

sentence_text: An example of ad measurement analysis would be if certain Devices were served with an advertisement for “OUTLOGIC Sandwich Shop” on Wednesday, and location data then showed traffic at OUTLOGIC Sandwich Shop on Thursday or Friday was higher than average, OUTLOGIC Sandwich Shop might conclude that its ad campaign performed well.

sentence_text: We collect three basic types of information about you in connection with our services: client data, visitor data, and prospect data, which relate to clients, visitors, and prospects respectively.

sentence_text: In particular, we collect:
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: Client data:
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: (a) Registration Information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: When you create an account on the Platform, we collect the following required information about you: email address, first and last names, and phone number.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: You must enter the above information yourself to create an account unless we receive such information (except phone number) about you from the Gmail authentication token when you choose to sign up using the ‘Sign In with Google’ button.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: (b) Authentication Token Information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: When you create an account on the Platform through the ‘Sign In with Google’ button, we collect encrypted Gmail authentication token obtained from Google LLC.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: We can obtain the following information about you via such a token: first and last names, email address, language settings .
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: (c) Automatically Collected Information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: When you create an account, we collect certain information about you and your device automatically, including, IP Address, referral link, registration date, account balance information, language, and browser type.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: We may also collect some information about your activity on the Platform, such as the time you purchased a subscription or renewed your plan.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: (d) Workplace Information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: When you create an account on the Platform, we collect some general information about your workplace and the purpose for using our Platform so that we can develop and optimize our Platform to meet the needs of our customers.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: Collecting workplace information allows us to know specifically who the processing agent is in order to expedite communication, e.g. in the event we receive a request from a data subject.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: Such information includes your company name, approximate company size, your occupation and purpose for using our Platform.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: If you order services from us, you will need to provide certain personal details, including payment information, so the order can be fulfilled.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: What Personal Information We Collect and Why
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Dun & Bradstreet collects information on businesses and business professionals, including personal information, so we can supply our customers with data about organizations and people.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Our purpose is to enable businesses, organizations, and public sector entities to manage their financial risks, protect against fraud and dishonesty, know who they are dealing with, meet their compliance and regulatory obligations, market their products and services, and better understand organizations, industries, markets, and people.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: We also collect personal information so that we can license and sell professional business contact information and personal contact information for marketing and data management purposes.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: We also collect personal information to continually improve our AI platform and enable companies to engage their buyers with 1-to-1 omni-channel experience and make B2B marketing as personalized as B2C marketing.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: The information that we collect includes, but is not limited to, the following:
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Company and business professional information, including business contact information such as name, title, address, phone number, fax number, and e-mail address, domain names, FEIN numbers, trade associations, utility bills, incorporation and tax records and information on minority, women, and veteran owned businesses.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: In addition, we corroborate and build business contact emails by way of various verification methods and data points;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Detailed company profiles and statistics, including number of employees;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Background information regarding company management and employees, including beneficial ownership/persons of significant control, the educational and career histories of company principals, company and individual browsing history, and adverse media history including but not limited to any history of criminal acts or misconduct, where collection of such data is permitted and where such data is not deemed sensitive under applicable laws;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Company operational histories, including territories, subsidiaries, affiliates, and lines of business;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Detailed trade and business credit information, including payment histories and patterns;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Summary business information regarding profitability, debts, assets, net worth, and business relationships;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Business violations, publicly available disclosures and other compliance information from public source government and professional records, media and business publications;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Website and online data relating to IP addresses, geolocation, comments on social media are collected and used to analyze trends regarding Dun & Bradstreet products and services and to increase accuracy of our business data sets, as well as to assist us in matching IP addresses to business contact information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: When a user opts into the installation of D&B Email IQ, the application will access limited data from the emails and calendar invites the user sends and receives in their email environment.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: The data collected will be limited to email addresses found in the “To” and “From” fields of the emails, as well as the business card information contained in an email signature.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: The signature of an email may include data elements such as name, job title and department, company name, email address, telephone number, fax number, company address, corporate URL, and social networking URL.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Data collected via the application may be incorporated into the Dun & Bradstreet Data Cloud and be used to enhance and improve our products by enabling businesses to manage their financial risks, protect against fraud and dishonesty, know who they are doing business with, meet their compliance and regulatory obligations and better understand organizations, industries and markets.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Where permitted under applicable law, this information may also be used for sales and marketing purposes.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Based on the country of origin of the data subject, we have implemented safeguards to address additional legal obligations so that we are in compliance with applicable laws.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: In certain instances, the data collected will be used purely for internal compliance with applicable laws, unless further notice or consent requirements have been fulfilled.

sentence_text: We may collect the following types of Personal Data about you such as:
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: Identifiers, such as your name, email address, physical address, telephone number, and other contact information.

sentence_text: Your physical characteristics or a description of you;
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: Protected class and demographic information, such as your age (including birthdates), military or veteran status, and your gender.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: Commercial information, such as salary and wage information and history, credit check history, household income data, and loan information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: Internet or other electronic network activity information, such as your browsing history, search history, and information regarding your interactions with and use of our Digital Properties, including via cookies and other tracking technologies.

sentence_text: Please see Section 5 for further information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: Audio, electronic, visual, or other sensory information, such as photographs or security camera footage in public areas of Carvana’s facilities (including reception, the work floor, conference rooms, parking, and other general areas) if you participate in on-site activities, such as a job fair, job interview or aptitude test, as well as photographs, audio, or footage collected in the course of video interviews or through an online applicant platform, or other recordings.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: We may use Personal Data for the following purposes:

sentence_text: In connection with your application, such as assessing your application, interview, and test results for suitability for the position for which you have applied or other open positions; communicating with you concerning job openings or your application; conducting pre-employment verification and screening; offering you the job position, in our discretion; notifying you of job opportunities (including from affiliates in our group, where we have shared your job application with them); and dealing with any inquiry, challenge, or request for feedback received in relation to our recruitment and hiring decisions.

sentence_text: For our internal business purposes, such as managing and improving our recruitment process (for example, enhancing our scouting and talent identification processes); enforcing our policies and rules; and operating our diversity and inclusion initiatives.

sentence_text: For legal, safety or security reasons, such as complying with legal requirements, processes, or orders; complying with reporting and similar requirements; complying with government inspections and other requests from government or other public authorities; pursuing legal rights and remedies; investigating and responding to claims against Carvana and its customers and employees; monitoring and managing equal opportunity programs; screening and conducting background checks (as required or permitted by law); protecting our, your, our customers’, and other individuals’ safety, property or rights; addressing security and health and safety issues (including managing spread of communicable diseases) and malicious, deceptive, fraudulent, or illegal activity; ascertaining your eligibility for work; and receiving legal advice or approval.

sentence_text: Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed;Categories of Personal Information Sold

sentence_text: Our Digital Properties and the third parties that we authorize may use the following tracking technologies:
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: Some cookies exist only during a single session and some are persistent over multiple sessions over time.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: As a broad summary, in our business we use information about people:

sentence_text: We may automatically collect certain information about the computer or devices (including mobile devices) you use to access the Services.

sentence_text: For example, we may collect and analyze information such as (a) IP addresses, geolocation information (as described in the next section below), unique device identifiers including mobile advertising identifiers and other information about your mobile phone or other mobile device(s), browser types, browser language, operating system, the state or country from which you accessed the Services; and (b) information related to the ways in which you interact with the Services, such as: referring and exit pages and URLs, platform type, clicked items, interaction with advertisements, domain names, landing pages, pages and content viewed and the order of those pages, the amount of time spent on particular pages, mouse hover including location and time spent on each area of the page, the date and time you used the Services, the frequency of your use of the Services, error logs, and other similar information.
verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

sentence_text: As described further below, we may use third-party analytics providers and technologies, including cookies and similar tools, to assist in collecting and analyzing this information.

sentence_text: We may collect different types of information about your location, including general information (e.g., IP address, ZIP code) and more specific information (e.g., GPS-based functionality on mobile devices used to access the Services), and may use that information to customize the Services with location-based information, advertising, and features.

sentence_text: For example, if your IP address indicates an origin in downtown Los Angeles, the Services may be customized with downtown Los Angeles-specific information and advertisements.

verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed

verbatim_labels: Categories of Personal Information Collected;Categories of Personal Information Shared / Disclosed
